summary: Documented, for the first time, that Card's className is sanctioned for overriding padding/radius/border/shadow via tailwind-merge conflict resolution (CONVENTIONS SS5), not just for layout. This mechanism already worked -- nothing in card.tsx changed -- but card.doc.ts never said so, and a consumer-side audit (service-portal, ~105 hand-rolled card surfaces) found real blockers this documents a path around: a whole component family whose house style is border-only (no shadow), and a grid with a track minimum narrower than Card's default 320px. Added a knownGaps entry noting a first-class prop may still be worth it if enough consumers reach for the same override -- tracked as issue #10, not resolved by this entry.

migration.manual: No code change. Consumers who were already using className to override Card's surface were doing something sanctioned, not a hack; card.doc.ts now says so.
